category.description: generic = usable by any commander in any army (subject to faction_restriction/battle_force_restriction if set); commander-specific = only usable if commander_unit_id's unit is in the army.

commander_unit_id.description: References an id in data/units.json (rank: commander or operative). Required (non-null) when category is 'commander-specific'.

pips.description: Null where a current primary source did not expose the printed pip value (see notes on the card). 0 is used for a card explicitly treated as a lower pip value while building the command hand (see notes) rather than its literal printed cost.

units_activated.description: Number of units the card issues orders to. Some advanced cards use conditional/variable wording instead of a flat integer -- use a short string in that case and flag effect_verified accordingly. Null where a current primary source did not expose the order count (see notes on the card).

unit_activation_restriction.description: e.g. 'trooper units only', 'vehicle units only' -- null if the card can order any eligible unit type.

battle_force_restriction.description: e.g. '501st Legion' -- narrower than a faction restriction, tied to a specific Battle Force build.
